description: Source code implementation for device model helper functions in a device management SDK, including functions to create devices, endpoints, resources, and metadata, with internal management of linked lists and string properties.

methods.name: icDevice * createDevice(const char * uuid,const char * deviceClass,uint8_t deviceClassVersion,const char * deviceDriverName,const DeviceDescriptor * dd)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new icDevice struct, copies provided properties, and adds metadata from the device descriptor if available.

methods.name: icDeviceMetadata * createDeviceMetadata(icDevice * device,const char * metadataId,const char * value)
methods.description: Creates device metadata and assigns its URI based on device UUID and metadata ID.

methods.name: icDeviceEndpoint * createEndpoint(icDevice * device,const char * id,const char * profile,bool enabled)
methods.description: Creates a device endpoint, duplicates profile and id, sets enabled flag, and appends to device endpoints list.

methods.name: icDeviceResource * createDeviceResource(icDevice * device,const char * resourceId,const char * value,const char * type,uint8_t mode,ResourceCachingPolicy cachingPolicy)
methods.description: Creates a device resource with specified parameters and adds it to device resources list.

methods.name: icDeviceResource * createDeviceResourceIfAvailable(icDevice * device,const char * resourceId,icInitialResourceValues * initialResourceValues,const char * type,uint8_t mode,ResourceCachingPolicy cachingPolicy)
methods.description: Checks initial resource values for device-specific value, creates resource if available.

methods.name: icDeviceResource * createEndpointResource(icDeviceEndpoint * endpoint,const char * resourceId,const char * value,const char * type,uint8_t mode,ResourceCachingPolicy cachingPolicy)
methods.description: Creates a resource for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: icDeviceResource * createEndpointResourceIfAvailable(icDeviceEndpoint * endpoint,const char * resourceId,icInitialResourceValues * initialResourceValues,const char * type,uint8_t mode,ResourceCachingPolicy cachingPolicy)
methods.description: Checks initial resource values for endpoint-specific value, creates resource if available.

methods.name: icDeviceMetadata * createDeviceMetadataOnList(icLinkedList * metadataList,const char * endpointId,const char * metadataId,const char * deviceUuid,const char * value)
methods.description: Allocates and appends device metadata to a list, setting its URI.

methods.name: icDeviceMetadata * createEndpointMetadata(icDeviceEndpoint * endpoint,const char * metadataId,const char * value)
methods.description: Creates endpoint metadata and sets its URI based on endpoint info.

methods.name: icDeviceResource * createDeviceResourceOnList(icLinkedList * resourceList,const char * endpointId,const char * resourceId,const char * deviceUuid,const char * value,const char * type,uint8_t mode,ResourceCachingPolicy cachingPolicy)
